title: Build an AI-powered paper trading bot over the June 19th long weekend
author: OptionomicsAI
selftext:
If you’ve been looking for a real weekend project around AI + trading automation, we wrote a hands-on tutorial for building an LLM-powered paper trading bot from scratch.

The bot takes an Optionomics Trade Ideas webhook, enriches it with live market context through the Optionomics MCP server, asks an LLM for a structured decision, runs deterministic risk gates, logs everything to SQLite, and can submit a paper equity order through Alpaca.

The flow looks like this:

1. Optionomics Trade Idea fires

2. FastAPI webhook receives the alert

3. Bot validates the payload and deduplicates the event

4. LLM reviews the setup using Optionomics MCP tools

5. Model returns a typed TradingDecision

6. Deterministic gates approve or reject it

7. Result is logged

8. Alpaca paper order is sent only if everything passes

The important part: this is not a “let the LLM YOLO your account” bot.

If you have a few hours over the June 19th long weekend, this is a solid project to build, run locally, test with curl/ngrok, and then connect to real Trade Ideas alerts in paper mode.

Blog post: [https://docs.optionomics.ai/build-optionomics-webhook-mcp-llm-trading-bot/](https://docs.optionomics.ai/build-optionomics-webhook-mcp-llm-trading-bot/)

Not financial advice, not a profitable strategy promise, and definitely not something to point at a live account without serious testing. The goal is to show a safer integration pattern for AI-assisted trading workflows.
